principles.lesson: Late discovery was primarily a universe-source problem. Top gainers/unusual-volume lists are reactive and often introduce symbols after +20%. The new engine must score origin timing separately from ranking quality.

Discovery, decision and compliance must be separate layers. Missing catalyst/Sharia/enrichment lowers confidence or execution eligibility but must not erase an emerging market anomaly from research view.
High RVOL after a large move is not early discovery. First-seen change and signal origin must cap discovery credit.
Single snapshots are insufficient. First seen, velocity, persistence slope, peak-referenced gain retention and session-scoped trajectories are required.
Catalyst relevance, source quality, freshness and timing must be validated before catalyst credit. Post-signal news cannot explain signal origin.
Intraperiod evidence supports live decisions, but final training truth requires reconciled final snapshots. Training eligibility must not block live research presentation.
Do not build a stack of release overlays. Maintain one state model, one render path and one release authority.
The user needs why-now, what-blocks, entry condition, invalidation, catalyst context, data freshness and origin timing before technical diagnostics.
Fail closed only for claims that require verification: execution compliance and training truth. Do not fail closed the entire discovery surface because one enrichment field is absent.
Success is Early Capture below +10/+20, remaining upside at first alert, lead time and false ignition rate—not version count or number of integrity gates.
